overview.text: 外 means “outside” or “external,” and can also mean “foreign.” Bronze inscriptions use it for “outside”; its earliest construction is disputed.

components.text: One interpretation reads 卜 as a divination crack whose direction marks “outside”; this account of the early graph remains disputed.
月 is reported as a sound element in bronze forms; similar Old Chinese readings make this plausible, but do not prove it.
